items.title: Chuck Israels interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 11, 2021
items.q: I don’t remember whether it was John Coltrane or Kenny Dorham or one of the wind players that went, “Oh let’s play this.”

ctx.x: Yes and boy that was just something — something that just happened. I had this little extra song. I was doing a counterpoint exercise, and, at the time for my theory class at

Brandeis. And I thought okay I’m going to take these two little figures and juxtapose them — and they’re sort of harmonically ambiguous enough that they can go against each other, against changing harmony, they’re kind of non-committal melodically in that sense and I put them one here and one here and one here and one here, I just tried to figure out a way that these two things would fit together and make a little tune. And it was just sitting on my music stand and I don’t remember whether it was John Coltrane or…
